implementation: Virtual planning ignores contacts; execution gates determine termination. Invalid contacts retain disqualification/penalties but do not shorten unsuccessful episodes. Numerical/reference/pose failures terminate as failures. Credit and visualization stop at event. Offline export crops to next 30 Hz boundary and appends recovery.
